title: Classify EUR context activation tick sources
changes: Identify the bounded 40-word context tick table and independently rooted 40-byte conditional gate, distinguishing both immutable sources from live counter and activation flags.
validation: Wine e141-late-residue-wine-px0r_2m1 observes all 40 tick words in one ordinary three-frame window; Wine e142-context-copy-dis-wine-igwmrii5 inspects the original indexed comparison, mode/gate condition and RAM flag write. Earlier disassembly attempt rs6vfcmi omitted an asserted address and was corrected.
limitations: The observed mode did not establish ordinary gate reads or a matching activation. Source model, runtime integration, other consumers, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance measurement.
